title: LejaSmart
description: A web-based financial ledger and business management platform designed to digitize informal market commerce. Provides automated bookkeeping, inventory tracking, role-based dashboards, and live P&L reporting.
role: Lead Developer — Architected, built, and deployed full system.
problem: Local vendors and small businesses in informal markets rely on fragile paper ledgers, causing frequent calculation mistakes, misplaced records, and friction when reporting to remote accountants.
learned: Designed a resilient relational schema for concurrent transaction logging, containerized the Go service with Docker, and implemented real-time ledger updates via WebSockets.

title: Bitcoin Node Explorer
description: A high-performance Bitcoin blockchain inspection tool built in Go using Bitcoin Core JSON-RPC. Features deep block parsing, transaction verification, and Lightning state channel visibility.
role: Backend Engineer — Implemented RPC drivers & concurrent block queries.
problem: Lack of accessible visibility into Bitcoin off-chain Layer 2 state channels (HTLCs) and transaction mempool dynamics without bulky full node GUI setups.
learned: Mastered Go concurrency primitives (goroutines, worker pools, channels) to manage high-throughput RPC streaming and handle complex off-chain state verification.

title: Ujuzi360 LMS Platform
description: An enterprise learning management system featuring modular course authoring, automated enrollment pipelines, student progress tracking, and interactive quizzes.
role: Backend Developer — Designed Spring Boot microservices & auth architecture.
problem: Schools and training bootcamps struggle with disjointed tools for grading, content distribution, and tracking cohort progression under tight network conditions.
learned: Built robust Spring Boot RESTful APIs with JPA/Hibernate, strict JWT role authentication, and smooth React client integration.

title: LakeProof Supply Chain
description: A digital provenance platform tracking fisheries through the strict lifecycle: Catch → Landing → Transport → Processing → Market with tamper-evident digital audits.
role: Backend & Core Architecture — Built data integrity & lifecycle tracking engine.
problem: Small-scale fisheries depend on trustworthy catch provenance, but data is fragmented across SMS threads, paper receipts, and isolated intermediaries.
learned: Designed immutable audit logs ensuring data submitted at landing stations cannot be retroactively altered, maintaining supply chain transparency from lake to market.
